subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 5: mad/made, cap/cape, hat/hate, sit/site, kit/kite

show.line: Add e at the end and the vowel says its name! Cap, cape. Kit, kite.

rounds.praise: Yes! Cape. The e makes a say its name.
Yes! Kit. No e at the end.

rounds.prompt: Which one flies in the wind?
Short sound or long sound? Sort the words.

hints: Look for the e at the end. It makes the vowel say its name.
Hat, hate. Listen to the change.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It says made. The e at the end changes the sound.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. Made. The e is magic!

parent_line: Knows that an e at the end makes the vowel long: cap and cape, kit and kite.
